I lost my doggy about a week ago and I still see him everywhere. He used to sit on a specific tread on staircase so back then it was really hard to step past him without stepping on his tail. Now everytime I step on that tread, it reminds me of that void, Two days ago before I headed out for some errand, I looked for him to say goodbye as usual,  but he was nowhere and then I remembered he was gone. Still it doesn't feel real. I still hear how his paws make that tip tap sound while he walks , or how he climbs up a chair. He used to have this cutest smile and he had bright eyes that lights up every time you look at him, in his last few days he stopped wanting to run around, his smile faded away, still his eyes had the same kind of brightness. I can't imagine how much of pain he had to go through physically in his last days and I can't shake away the memories of his eyes slowly blinking looking right at me as if he was telling me that it hurts. I wish I could've told him that I'm right there with him and not to be afraid,  I did! Many times! But I wish he understood what I was saying. Life feels so incomplete without him and I have this longing feeling to hug him for one more time. I know we are supposed to let go of the past and be strong and all, but I'm not ready to let go of my baby. He  was the funniest,  kindest and the best dog ever. 
Rest in peace love ❤ we'll meet under the same stars once again ❤
